title: Why Drainage Lines Gurgle and Drain Slowly
description: Slow draining sinks accompanied by gurgling noises in a building's drainage system are often caused by improper venting or a partial blockage down the line. When water flows down an unvented or restricted pipe, it creates a negative pressure zone behind the fluid column. Air is then pulled through the nearest trap seal, causing a distinct gurgling sound and disrupting smooth flow. Resolving this requires verifying vent stack clarity and clearing obstructions downstream. Always check local plumbing codes for proper vent sizing and distance rules to prevent trap siphoning.
